text:
erin: heads-up: p99 spikes on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate when I slice by endpoint_version=2026-03 but p50/p95 steady. no infra deploys. anyone seen a variant-mix tail like this?

matt: dashboard or raw query?

erin: dashboard. pulled a snapshot: global p50=110ms p95=270ms p99=800ms; version=2026-03 p50=112ms p95=275ms p99=2.3s. sample_count for that slice ~3k.

yasmin: first suspicion = aggregation mode flip (tdigest->histogram) for low counts. telemetry-bot, what rollup modes are active?

telemetry-bot: rollup modes: tdigest if samples >= 10k; histogram if 1k <= samples < 10k; raw-sample if samples < 1k. (telemetry/rollups.md)

matt: 3k -> histogram. hist bucket size for this endpoint set is 60ms. histograms + a few multi-second requests will push p99.

erin: I grouped by model_variant and found something interesting: variant=fp32 has p99 ~850ms, variant=qs8 (quantized 8-bit) p99 ~2.1s but variant=qs8 is only ~0.9% of slice.

yasmin: oh, routing mixed model variants for that endpoint_version? that explains a tiny origin dominating the tail.

ops: note: routing policies allow fallback to qs8 during gpu contention for lower cost; that fallback is weighted but can surface in traces.

erin: so the dashboard p99 is computed across variants and histogram coarse buckets make the small qs8 tail dominate.

matt: two paths: UX quick fix = surface rollup provenance + sample_count + dominant_tag (model_variant) next to p99. Also surface a prompt: "split by model_variant" when provenance!=tdigest.

yasmin: agree. medium-term: change percentile aggregation logic when slices include tagged origins with distinct performance profiles. e.g., compute p99 per-variant then show a blended percentile with disclosure.

console-ui: suggestion: badge text example: "p99 (histogram, bucket=60ms) sample_count=3050 dominant=model_variant:qs8 (0.9%)"

erin: adding to ticket: CONSOLE-4721 with SQL + screenshots. SQL used for repro: 
```
SELECT minute, count(*) n, pctl(0.99, latency_ms) p99, model_variant
FROM requests
WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND endpoint_version='2026-03'
GROUP BY minute, model_variant
ORDER BY minute DESC
LIMIT 30;
```

matt: also paste raw histogram bucket counts for the minute of the spike so platform can see top-bucket mass.

ops: longer-term infra change: consider routing metadata that marks variant_as_noncritical for SLO panels, or emit separate SLO-only metrics excluding fallback variants.

yasmin: or require a minimum tail-sample threshold when using histogram-derived percentiles (e.g., at least 50 samples in top 1% region) before surfacing p99 as primary. Otherwise show a confidence low indicator.

erin: great. I'll include both the low-effort UX items and the medium-term blending proposals in the ticket. tagging @matt @yasmin @ops.

console-ui: small addition: auto-suggest "split by model_variant" and "filter out fallback variants" quick actions when p99 > 2x p95 and provenance!=tdigest.

matt: nice. that reduces pager churn. also add a debug link to raw traces for the spike minutes.

erin: ticket created CONSOLE-4721 and attached queries, histograms, and a short video of the panel. closing thread, thanks :raised_hands:
